project.name: Selemene Engine
assumptions: Railway remains the primary deployment target
Supabase PostgreSQL stays as the auth/data backend
FreeAstrologyAPI free tier (50 req/day) is sufficient for current traffic
TypeScript engines (Tarot, I-Ching, Enneagram, Sacred Geometry, Sigil Forge) decision deferred to Phase 3
Single developer (Shesh) is primary contributor; est_hours reflect solo pace
Swiss Ephemeris data files are stable and won't need updates
No breaking API changes — all improvements are additive or behind feature flags
risks: Hardcoded JWT secret in railway-setup.sh — anyone with repo access can forge tokens
OpenTelemetry version mismatch blocks observability feature enablement
Release pipeline binary name mismatch means no automated GitHub Releases
Redis L2 disabled — cache misses fall through to recalculation, higher latency under load
Integration test SIGTRAP masked by continue-on-error — real failures may be hidden
FreeAstrologyAPI rate limit (50/day) could become bottleneck if traffic grows
noesis-vedic-api has 2 todo!() calls that will panic on certain API response formats

phases.name: Critical Security & Pipeline Fixes
phases.objective: Eliminate security vulnerabilities, fix broken CI/CD pipelines, and ensure the release process works end-to-end

tasks.title: Rotate JWT secret and remove hardcoded value
tasks.deliverable: New JWT secret generated via `openssl rand -base64 48`, set in Railway dashboard, hardcoded value removed from `scripts/railway-setup.sh:89`
tasks.acceptance: No JWT secrets exist in any committed file and production tokens validate with the new secret

tasks.title: Fix release workflow binary name mismatch
tasks.deliverable: `.github/workflows/release.yml` updated to package `noesis-server` instead of `selemene-engine`
tasks.acceptance: A test tag push produces a GitHub Release with correctly named binaries for all 3 platforms

tasks.title: Fix OpenTelemetry version mismatch
tasks.deliverable: Aligned `opentelemetry` and `tracing-opentelemetry` versions in `noesis-api/Cargo.toml`
tasks.acceptance: `cargo build --features otel` compiles without errors and `logging.rs` OpenTelemetry setup initializes

tasks.title: Fix noesis-vedic-api todo!() panics
tasks.deliverable: Replace 2 `todo!()` calls in `noesis-vedic-api/src/panchang/mod.rs` (lines 308, 313) with proper Tithi/Nakshatra parsing
tasks.acceptance: All FreeAstrologyAPI response formats parse without panicking and tests cover the new code paths

tasks.title: Add secret scanning to CI
tasks.deliverable: GitHub secret scanning or `trufflehog` step added to `test.yml` workflow
tasks.acceptance: CI fails if any committed file contains patterns matching API keys, JWT secrets, or database credentials

tasks.title: Verify release pipeline end-to-end
tasks.deliverable: Successful test release (v0.1.1-rc1) with binaries for Linux x86_64, macOS x86_64, macOS ARM64
tasks.acceptance: GitHub Release page shows 3 downloadable binaries and Docker image is pushed to ghcr.io

phases.name: Infrastructure Hardening
phases.objective: Re-enable Redis L2 cache, fix CI gaps, align Docker configs, and implement real system metrics

tasks.title: Re-enable Redis L2 cache operations
tasks.deliverable: All 8 TODO markers in `noesis-cache` resolved with working Redis GET/SET/EXPIRE operations
tasks.acceptance: Cache hit/miss metrics show L2 Redis serving cached responses and latency drops measurably for repeated requests

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL service to CI
tasks.deliverable: PostgreSQL service container added to `.github/workflows/test.yml` with migrations auto-applied
tasks.acceptance: Auth integration tests run in CI against real Postgres and pass without `continue-on-error`

tasks.title: Fix integration test SIGTRAP on cleanup
tasks.deliverable: Root cause of SIGTRAP identified and fixed, `continue-on-error: true` removed from CI
tasks.acceptance: Integration test suite completes cleanly (exit 0) with no signal crashes

tasks.title: Implement real CPU and memory metrics
tasks.deliverable: Replace `0.0` stubs in `noesis-metrics` (lines 399-400, 432-434) with `sysinfo` or `/proc` readings
tasks.acceptance: `/metrics` endpoint returns non-zero CPU and memory values that match system state

tasks.title: Align Docker development and production configs
tasks.deliverable: `docker-compose.yml` updated to use `Dockerfile.prod` or a clearly documented dev/prod distinction
tasks.acceptance: `docker-compose up` builds with same Rust version as production and uses `/health/live` for health checks

tasks.title: Add Redis L2 cache integration tests
tasks.deliverable: Integration tests verifying L1->L2->L3 cache flow, TTL expiry, and cache invalidation
tasks.acceptance: Tests pass in CI with Redis service container and demonstrate correct cache hierarchy behavior

tasks.title: Enable OpenTelemetry tracing in production
tasks.deliverable: OpenTelemetry feature enabled in production build with OTLP exporter configured
tasks.acceptance: Traces appear in Sentry or a configured OTLP backend with request spans for engine calculations

tasks.title: Add per-engine calculation latency histograms
tasks.deliverable: Prometheus histograms recording calculation time per engine ID
tasks.acceptance: `/metrics` shows `engine_calculation_duration_seconds` histogram with labels for each engine

tasks.title: Add cache hit rate metrics
tasks.deliverable: Prometheus counters for L1/L2/L3 cache hits and misses
tasks.acceptance: `/metrics` shows `cache_hits_total` and `cache_misses_total` counters with layer labels

tasks.title: Create Grafana dashboard template
tasks.deliverable: JSON dashboard template with panels for request rate, latency p50/p95/p99, cache hit rates, and system resources
tasks.acceptance: Dashboard imports into Grafana and displays live data from the `/metrics` endpoint

tasks.title: Add health check for FreeAstrologyAPI availability
tasks.deliverable: `/health/ready` includes FreeAstrologyAPI status check with rate limit remaining
tasks.acceptance: Readiness probe reports API status and remaining daily quota in health response

tasks.title: Add alerting rules for critical thresholds
tasks.deliverable: Alerting rules for: error rate >5%, p95 latency >500ms, FreeAstrologyAPI quota <10 remaining
tasks.acceptance: Test alerts fire correctly when thresholds are breached and route to configured notification channel
